## When ARGUS suggests it

Sleep duration is at Watch or higher and the Reaction Self-Test is at Watch or higher.

## Steps

1. Protect your next sleep window. [SRC_SLEEP_BARGER]
2. Follow light and schedule hygiene. [demo wording]
3. Avoid critical tasks if your lapses are high. [demo wording]
4. Re-test with the Reaction Self-Test. [demo wording]
5. Send a report to the flight surgeon. [demo wording]
